title: 5/3/1 Deload Week
author: Brian
desc: The **5/3/1 Deload Week** program is straight from 5/3/1 Forever. Work up to your training max from the last training block. Hit a single if you know your training max is correct and you just need a Deload week. Or you can test your training max to make sure you can get 3-5 reps. If you cant’t, your training max is probably too high and should be adjusted for your next block. You can also go for a rep PR. There is no supplemental work and less assistance work since it’s a Deload. Feel free to swap assistance exercises. Always use this protocol between a Leader and an Anchor template and before starting a new Leader template.
